### PyChrono Simulation of a FEDA Vehicle on Rigid Terrain

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr
from pychrono.vehicle import *

# 1. Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components.
chrono.ChEngine.Initialize()

# 2. Create the Irrlicht application
application = irr.IrrlichtApplication()

# 3. Create a FEDA vehicle
vehicle = chrono.vehicle.FEDA()

# 4. Set vehicle parameters
vehicle.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
vehicle.SetTireModel(chrono.vehicle.ChTire_Model_TME)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(0.01)
vehicle.EnableTireStepSize(0.01)

# 5. Set vehicle location and orientation
vehicle.SetChassisBodyFixed(False)
vehicle.SetChassisPosition(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1))
vehicle.SetChassisOrientation(chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0))

# 6. Add vehicle to the simulation
application.Add(vehicle.GetChassisBody())

# 7. Create a rigid terrain
terrain = chrono.vehicle.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
terrain.SetTexture(chrono.ChTexture(chrono.ChVector2d(10, 10), "terrain.jpg"))
terrain.Initialize()

# 8. Add terrain to the simulation
application.Add(terrain.GetGroundBody())

# 9. Create a driver system
driver = chrono.vehicle.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vehicle)
driver.Initialize()

# 10. Set camera to follow the vehicle
camera = irr.ChCamera()
camera.SetPosition(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -10, 5))
camera.SetTarget(vehicle.GetChassisBody().GetPos())
application.SetCamera(camera)

# 11. Simulation loop
while application.Run(1 / 50.0):
    vehicle.Update(1 / 50.0)
    driver.Update(1 / 50.0)
    application.Render()
```

        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
